newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak ahead of 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to remain weak on Friday ahead of the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) budget to be announced later in the day, dealers said.

"Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif has portrayed a bad picture of the economy which will take long time to revive," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But in the special budget session in the evening, there is likely to be some speculative interest."
On Thursday, the index fell 13.74 points, or 0.87 percent, to end at 1,571.42. Losers led gainers 216 to 48. Turnover fell to 45.76 million shares from 49.07 million on Wednesday.
